problem.root_cause: A low-tier shared component (the legacy-cron-scheduler, since decommissioned) failed overnight. Its own catalogued criticality was routine, so it was first logged as a minor incident; the true impact only became clear once the on-call manager mapped the service dependency graph and found that a large number of most-critical customer-facing services depended on it. It was then declared a major incident and prioritised accordingly.

sys_script.name: Derive priority from impact and urgency
